usage: 一個 is used to count singular items or objects.
It is placed before the noun to specify 'one' of something.
一個 can also refer to a person or thing as a unit.
When asking questions, 一個 helps specify one item from a group.
It works together with classifiers (measure words) usually like 個 go3.

examples.jyutping: ngo5 jiu3 maai5 jat1 go3 ping4 gwo2.
examples.meaning: I want to buy one apple.
